name: godot-mcp
description: MCP server for interfacing with Godot game engine. Provides tools for launching the editor, running projects, and capturing debug output.
author: Solomon Elias <solomon@sippy.ai>

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit false --outDir dist && node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); fs.rmSync('dist/scripts', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.cpSync('src/scripts', 'dist/scripts', { recursive: true })"
